field.label: CPU temperature alerts
field.help: Check CPU core temperatures and notify if the hottest core exceeds the configured limit twice in succession. Once cooled, a recovery message is sent. Requires the CPU thermal sensors to be available in OPNsense.

field.label: CPU temperature limit
field.help: Alert when CPU temperature exceeds this limit. Allowed range: 40–105 °C; default: 75 °C. The CPU is considered cool again once its hottest core stays at least 5 °C below the limit for two readings. The system checks about every 20 seconds.
